recipes.name: Goodles Mac & Cheese
ing: 1 box Goodles (one box is one meal — you have three this week)
Whatever the box directions call for

steps.t: Make the whole box per its directions.
Optional, for more food: microwave a cup of frozen broccoli, covered, while the pasta boils, then fold it in.
Optional, for more protein: off the heat, stir in ½ cup cottage cheese. Small-curd melts most of the way into the sauce — it stays a little textured rather than perfectly smooth.

extra.label: Optional mix-ins
items: ½ cup cottage cheese — +90 cal, +12g protein
1 cup frozen broccoli — +30 cal, a noticeably bigger bowl

recipes.note: The box already carries 38g of protein on its own, which is why it does not strictly need a mix-in. Dropping the two sausage links takes about 280 calories off the meal you were eating last week.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Chicken Fajita Bowls
ing: 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into thin strips
3 bell peppers in different colors + 1 red onion, cut into strips
2 tbsp olive oil · 1 packet fajita seasoning · 1 lime
1½ rice pouches (1 cup cooked rice per bowl)
Salsa, a little shredded cheese, Greek yogurt

steps.t: Oven to 425°F. Foil on a sheet pan so there are no dishes.
Chicken, peppers, and onion onto the pan with the oil and the whole seasoning packet. Toss with your hands, then spread it out in a single layer — use a second pan if it is crowded.
Roast 20 min, until the pepper edges char and the thickest chicken strip is no longer pink inside.
Squeeze the lime over the whole pan and split it into three containers.
Microwave the rice and add 1 cup to each container.
When you eat: 2 tbsp salsa, a small pinch of cheese, and a spoon of Greek yogurt.

recipes.note: Hot oven, one layer, three colors. Crowded vegetables steam instead of charring, and those charred edges are exactly the flavor last month’s stir-fry was missing. Cooked Monday, it keeps well through Wednesday.

recipes.name: Turkey Pepperoni Tortilla Pizzas
ing: ¼ cup pizza sauce · 2 oz shredded mozzarella · 2 oz turkey pepperoni

steps.t: Oven to 425°F (or air fryer to 400°F). Tortillas in bare for 3 minutes first — crisping them before the sauce goes on is what keeps them from going soggy.
Sauce, mozzarella, and pepperoni on each.
Back in until the cheese bubbles, 5–6 min. Cut into wedges.

recipes.note: Two pizzas is one dinner. A thin tortilla base keeps both under 600 calories together, with more protein than a Goodles box.

recipes.name: Turkey & Cheese Wrap
ing: 5 oz deli turkey · 1 oz shredded cheese

steps.t: Microwave the tortilla for 10 seconds so it rolls without cracking.
Turkey, cheese, lettuce, tomato, and a line of mustard down the middle. Fold the sides in, then roll tight.

recipes.note: The lightest meal of the week. It pairs well with Greek yogurt and berries on a day you want the calories to go further.
